dict.string: A website you are visiting is asking to use your camera, for example for a video call. Zentic asks you first, every site separately, and nothing is recorded by Zentic itself.
A website you are visiting is asking to use your microphone, for example for a call or voice message. Zentic asks you first, every site separately, and nothing is recorded by Zentic itself.
A website you are visiting is asking where you are, for example to show nearby places. Zentic asks you first, every site separately, and never keeps or sends your location anywhere else.
